title: RitualDev — Autonomous AI Agent Defense Suite
excerpt: Enterprise runtime zero-leak defense, database guardrail proxy, and 96.7% context compaction for AI coding agents.
content_html:
v1.2.0 Stable

Zero-Leak Secret Defense & Kernel Sandbox for Autonomous AI Coding Agents

AgentShield wraps your AI agent processes (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity) inside OS-level kernel sandboxes. It traps unauthorized syscalls, redacts environment secrets in volatile memory, and blocks credential exfiltration with strict CIDR egress filtering.

Zero-Trust Isolation

Native Kernel Sandboxing Across All Three Operating Systems

Linux KernelProduction Hardened

Bubblewrap (bwrap) + Landlock LSM

Unprivileged user namespaces, read-only rootfs mounts, isolated network namespaces, and strict PID namespace confinement.

macOS DarwinNative Darwin

Apple Seatbelt (sandbox-exec)

Scheme-based sandbox profiles restricting file-read, file-write, sysctl inspection, and outbound mach-lookup messaging.

Windows NTNative Win32

LowBox / AppContainer Isolation

Windows AppContainer low-integrity execution token, restricted process tokens, and firewall capability filtering.

Wrapping Agent Executables in 1 Second

# Run Claude Code or Cursor through AgentShield kernel sandbox with egress lockdown

$ agentshield exec --network allow-git-only --profile strict -- claude

[agentshield] Initializing Landlock LSM file sandbox...

[agentshield] Mounting read-only system rootfs (isolate /etc, /var/log)...

[agentshield] Generating synthetic decoy canary for ~/.aws/credentials...

[agentshield] Active Egress CIDR: 140.82.112.0/20 (GitHub), 104.18.0.0/16 (Cloudflare)

[agentshield] Sandbox locked. Spawning agent PID 48191...

Live Status Bar Kernel Telemetry

Shows active sandbox enforcement (Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, AppContainer) and traps unauthorized egress sockets right from your status bar.

1-Click QuickFix Redactor (Ctrl+.)

Detects exposed AWS, OpenAI, GitHub, and database keys on keystroke. Press Ctrl+. to instantly replace raw secrets with secure environment references.

Anti-Exfiltration Hook

Prevents autonomous agent prompts from reading /proc/self/environ, ~/.ssh, or piping private keys into chat context.

Zero-Leak Telemetry Badge

Add our automated SVG status badge to your GitHub repository README to signal enterprise compliance, Landlock kernel sandboxing, and zero secret exfiltration.

Live Badge:

Markdown Embed Snippet

[![Secured by AgentShield](https://ritualdev.in/badge/secured.svg)](https://ritualdev.in)

HTML Embed Snippet

<a href="https://ritualdev.in"><img src="https://ritualdev.in/badge/secured.svg" alt="Secured by AgentShield" /></a>

Upgrade to AgentShield Pro

Includes native macOS/Windows menu-bar GUI, cloud audit log backup, and centralized policy sync.
